errors.bad_answer: The accessibility check could not read the answer of view {view}: {reason}
errors.bad_args: The accessibility check got arguments it cannot read: {reason}

rules.accesskeys: accesskey attribute value should be unique
rules.area-alt: Active <area> elements must have alternative text
rules.aria-allowed-attr: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
rules.aria-allowed-role: ARIA role should be appropriate for the element
rules.aria-braille-equivalent: aria-braille attributes must have a non-braille equivalent
rules.aria-command-name: ARIA commands must have an accessible name
rules.aria-conditional-attr: ARIA attributes must be used as specified for the element's role
rules.aria-deprecated-role: Deprecated ARIA roles must not be used
rules.aria-dialog-name: ARIA dialog and alertdialog nodes should have an accessible name
rules.aria-hidden-body: aria-hidden="true" must not be present on the document body
rules.aria-hidden-focus: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
rules.aria-input-field-name: ARIA input fields must have an accessible name
rules.aria-meter-name: ARIA meter nodes must have an accessible name
rules.aria-progressbar-name: ARIA progressbar nodes must have an accessible name
rules.aria-prohibited-attr: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes
rules.aria-required-attr: Required ARIA attributes must be provided
rules.aria-required-children: Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children
rules.aria-required-parent: Certain ARIA roles must be contained by particular parents
rules.aria-roledescription: aria-roledescription must be on elements with a semantic role
rules.aria-roles: ARIA roles used must conform to valid values
rules.aria-tab-name: ARIA tab nodes must have an accessible name
rules.aria-toggle-field-name: ARIA toggle fields must have an accessible name
rules.aria-tooltip-name: ARIA tooltip nodes must have an accessible name
rules.aria-treeitem-name: ARIA treeitem nodes should have an accessible name
rules.aria-valid-attr: ARIA attributes must conform to valid names
rules.aria-valid-attr-value: ARIA attributes must conform to valid values
rules.audio-caption: <audio> elements must have a captions track
rules.autocomplete-valid: autocomplete attribute must be used correctly
rules.avoid-inline-spacing: Inline text spacing must be adjustable with custom stylesheets
rules.blink: <blink> elements are deprecated and must not be used
rules.bypass: Page must have means to bypass repeated blocks
rules.color-contrast: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
rules.color-contrast-enhanced: Elements must meet enhanced color contrast ratio thresholds
rules.css-orientation-lock: CSS Media queries must not lock display orientation
rules.definition-list: <dl> elements must only directly contain properly-ordered <dt> and <dd> groups, <script>, <template> or <div> elements
rules.dlitem: <dt> and <dd> elements must be contained by a <dl>
rules.document-title: Documents must have <title> element to aid in navigation
rules.duplicate-id: id attribute value must be unique
rules.duplicate-id-active: IDs of active elements must be unique
rules.duplicate-id-aria: IDs used in ARIA and labels must be unique
rules.empty-table-header: Table header text should not be empty
rules.focus-order-semantics: Elements in the focus order should have an appropriate role
rules.form-field-multiple-labels: Form field must not have multiple label elements
rules.frame-focusable-content: Frames with focusable content must not have tabindex=-1
rules.frame-tested: Frames should be tested with axe-core
rules.frame-title: Frames must have an accessible name
rules.frame-title-unique: Frames must have a unique title attribute
rules.heading-order: Heading levels should only increase by one
rules.hidden-content: Hidden content on the page should be analyzed
rules.html-has-lang: <html> element must have a lang attribute
rules.html-lang-valid: <html> element must have a valid value for the lang attribute
rules.html-xml-lang-mismatch: HTML elements with lang and xml:lang must have the same base language
rules.identical-links-same-purpose: Links with the same name must have a similar purpose
rules.image-redundant-alt: Alternative text of images should not be repeated as text
rules.input-button-name: Input buttons must have discernible text
rules.input-image-alt: Image buttons must have alternative text
rules.label: Form elements must have labels
rules.label-content-name-mismatch: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
rules.label-title-only: Form elements should have a visible label
rules.landmark-banner-is-top-level: Banner landmark should not be contained in another landmark
rules.landmark-complementary-is-top-level: Aside should not be contained in another landmark
rules.landmark-contentinfo-is-top-level: Contentinfo landmark should not be contained in another landmark
rules.landmark-main-is-top-level: Main landmark should not be contained in another landmark
rules.landmark-no-duplicate-banner: Document should not have more than one banner landmark
rules.landmark-no-duplicate-contentinfo: Document should not have more than one contentinfo landmark
rules.landmark-no-duplicate-main: Document should not have more than one main landmark
rules.landmark-one-main: Document should have one main landmark
rules.landmark-unique: Landmarks should have a unique role or role/label/title (i.e. accessible name) combination
rules.link-in-text-block: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
rules.list: <ul> and <ol> must only directly contain <li>, <script> or <template> elements
rules.listitem: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>
rules.marquee: <marquee> elements are deprecated and must not be used
rules.meta-refresh: Delayed refresh under 20 hours must not be used
rules.meta-refresh-no-exceptions: Delayed refresh must not be used
rules.meta-viewport: Zooming and scaling must not be disabled
rules.meta-viewport-large: Users should be able to zoom and scale the text up to 500%
rules.nested-interactive: Interactive controls must not be nested
rules.no-autoplay-audio: <video> or <audio> elements must not play automatically
rules.p-as-heading:
Styled

elements must not be used as headings
rules.page-has-heading-one: Page should contain a level-one heading
rules.presentation-role-conflict: Elements marked as presentational should be consistently ignored
rules.region: All page content should be contained by landmarks
rules.role-img-alt: [role="img"] and [role="image"] elements must have alternative text
rules.scope-attr-valid: scope attribute should be used correctly
rules.scrollable-region-focusable: Scrollable region must have keyboard access
rules.select-name: Select element must have an accessible name
rules.server-side-image-map: Server-side image maps must not be used
rules.skip-link: The skip-link target should exist and be focusable
rules.summary-name: Summary elements must have discernible text
rules.svg-img-alt: <svg> elements with an img or image role must have alternative text
rules.tabindex: Elements should not have tabindex greater than zero
rules.table-duplicate-name: Tables should not have the same summary and caption
rules.table-fake-caption: Data or header cells must not be used to give caption to a data table.
rules.target-size: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
rules.td-has-header: Non-empty <td> elements in larger <table> must have an associated table header
rules.td-headers-attr: Table cell headers attributes must refer to other <th> elements in the same table
rules.th-has-data-cells: Table headers in a data table must refer to data cells
rules.valid-lang: lang attribute must have a valid value

exclude.description: CSS selectors of parts of the page axe leaves out (ads, third-party widgets).
exclude.help: CSS selectors of parts of the page axe leaves out, such as ads or third-party widgets you cannot fix. Example: .ad-slot, iframe[src*="youtube"].
exclude.label: Excluded selectors

include.description: CSS selectors of the only parts of the page axe checks; empty checks the whole page.
include.help: CSS selectors of the only parts of the page axe checks, for a component under work. Example: main, #checkout. Empty checks the whole page.
include.label: Included selectors

reportIncomplete.description: Also report what axe could not decide on its own ("needs review") as info findings.
reportIncomplete.help: Also reports what axe could not decide on its own (needs review) as info findings, so you can check them by hand. Off reports violations only.
reportIncomplete.label: Report results that need review

rules.description: Switch single axe rules on (true) or off (false) by their id, whatever the tags select - for example color-contrast: false.
rules.help: Switch single axe rules on or off by their id, whatever the tags select. Example: color-contrast to false while the design system is in flux, region to true.
rules.label: Rules on and off

tags.description: The axe tags whose rules run. A WCAG level includes the lower levels and versions (wcag22aa runs every WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA rule); other tags (best-practice, section508, EN-301-549, experimental) are taken as they are.
tags.help: Which axe rule sets run: a WCAG level such as wcag22aa includes the lower levels and versions; best-practice, section508, EN-301-549 and experimental add their own rules. Example: wcag22aa, best-practice.
tags.label: Rule tags

tools.check: Runs the axe-core accessibility rules (WCAG 2.2 AA by default) in the views - every view or the one of target - and answers the violations as findings, each with the views and breakpoints it was found in. tags overrides the setting a11y-axe.tags for this call.
